Subject: SIG evidence request — admin activity / PII handling

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing the SIG submission with our external assessor (BigFour). They asked for three deliverables related to admin activity: 1) a timebound snapshot of operator/admin activity covering the last 90 days, 2) an explanation of what fields are present (user id, role, action type, resource id, IP, timestamp, request payload markers), and 3) confirmation of PII redaction or masking for exported logs and how we prove non-repudiation (hash chain / manifest).

Can Redwood provide: an automated snapshot with a SHA256 manifest, optional PII redaction at export time (configurable patterns), and a way to run a limited live query (read-only) for ad-hoc checks during the audit window? Also please call out retention windows and whether we can request rolling snapshots vs on-demand extracts.

We need to share this with the assessor by next Thursday (2027-03-04). Any compliance or delivery constraints we should plan for?

Thanks,
Sam
Compliance Manager, AcmeHealth

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide and options so you can pick what fits the assessor's ask: 

- What we log: operator/admin actions (create/delete/config change), API keys and token lifecycle events (no secret material), session start/stop, role changes, model-deploy and routing events. Each row includes timestamp (ISO8601), actor (internal user id), role, action, resource id, source IP, request id, and optional request metadata fields (truncated request size, sanitized prompt markers).

- Retention: default retention for admin activity is 18 months; can be reduced to 90 days for scoped exports. Logs older than retention are purged per our retention policy; we can produce timeboxed snapshots for any window within retention.

- Export options: 1) Pre-signed S3 bundle with gzipped CSV or Parquet; 2) SFTP drop (we can push to your SFTP); 3) temporary read-only live-query SQL endpoint (managed, RBAC-controlled) for the assessor to run a set of queries.

- PII handling: two export modes — (A) redaction-at-export where we run regex-based masks on configured fields (email, phone, SSN patterns), and (B) tokenization where we replace raw values with deterministic pseudonyms and include a separate secure mapping only accessible under legal controls. Both modes include a manifest and SHA256 checksums for each file.

- Non-repudiation: we produce a signed manifest (SHA256 per file + HMAC over the manifest with a delivery timestamp). We can also provide a chain-of-custody note describing the export job id, operator who requested it, and delivery path.

- Sampling / on-demand queries: for SOC/SIG sampling we normally provide deterministic sampling seed so samples can be reproduced. Live-query access is available for a 48–72 hour window per assessor request; queries are restricted to read-only and audited.

I've attached a short note that lays out the options and delivery formats so you can pick which one the assessor prefers. If the assessor needs an SFTP push, please share the endpoint and a contact. If they prefer live queries, we need a window and allowed IPs.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Tell us which export mode (S3 bundle / SFTP drop / live-query) and whether PII-redaction or pseudonymization is required.
2) Confirm the audit window and desired sampling parameters (percentage or absolute sample size).
3) Provide delivery credentials or IP allowlist for the live-query.

I can turn around a 90-day snapshot + manifest within 48 hours once you confirm.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
